title: Reflect connected notes
description: A tall cone of violet-blue light in a field of turning stars, with a centred badge, gradient heading and lead at its base; under them two cards framed only by faint hairlines (a fading top rule and a centre divider), each with a wide 468×256 picture, a small line icon and a sentence whose bold ink lead-in runs into muted text. Pictures fade in as they enter the window. On phones the cards stack.
notes: media (the light cone, 806×849) and each card's media (468×256) are slots; empty, they are a glow wash and muted panels
